messages:
sarah.ng: FYI I'm seeing a sudden spike of 502s for requests that should match the fast-path rule. Traffic looks like it's falling back to the slower route.
ben.platform: on it. any quick signal which rule failed? matching, header rewriting, or upstream? :thinking:
kai-sre: traces show match hit count dropped to 0 at 1923456700. header x-route isn't being injected by the gateway anymore.
ben.platform: that sounds like the header rewrite plugin got nuked in the last deploy. I can flip a hot-toggle to reinstate the rewrite.
sarah.ng: great — can we do a conservative toggle (apply to 20% first) and watch latency/5xx? want to avoid a mass flip if something else is off.
luke: recommend using the emergency route-rewrite toggle we tested last month: toggle id rwr-ev-42. Command is:
```bash
# CLI
redwoodctl toggle apply --id rwr-ev-42 --scope traffic:percent=20 --set header_rewrite='x-route:fast'
```
ben.platform: I'll run that now and tail metrics. if errors go down we can ramp.
ops-bot: toggle rwr-ev-42 apply requested by ben.platform at 1923457050, scope=traffic:percent=20
ben.platform: applied. Grafana link: https://grafana.company/d/metrics/route-rewrites?from=now-5m&to=now
kai-sre: I see 502 rate dropping immediately, latency stable. but a handful of requests still 502 with trace id 0f4b9a2.
sarah.ng: any sign of quota enforcement on the slow route causing 502s? could be rate-limit headers not forwarded.
ben.platform: checked quotas — no surge. the trace shows upstream rejecting due to missing x-route header. so the rewrite fix should resolve most.
luke: if we need rollback do this:
```bash
# disable toggle
redwoodctl toggle disable --id rwr-ev-42
# or control-plane API
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/toggles/rwr-ev-42/disable -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
kai-sre: create a short runbook note in incidents channel once stable. also dump gateway logs for 2m before toggle for postmortem.
ben.platform: will increase to 60% in 5m if metrics look good.
ops-bot: toggle rwr-ev-42 scope updated to traffic:percent=60 by ben.platform at 1923457120
sarah.ng: all green from product side — core flows restored, no regression seen in integrations smoke tests.
kai-sre: scheduling rollback window at +30m if error budget creeps. also I created a temporary alert on the route match rate and header-insert failures.
ben.platform: leaving a note in the console rollout UI: 'Emergency header-rewrite toggle rwr-ev-42 applied to mitigate missing header regression from last deploy. Ramping 20->60%. Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3245'
sarah.ng: thanks. after 1h if stable we'll mark incident resolved and copy steps to postmortems/ (include exact commands + grafana panels + trace ids). :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: INC-2026-0427 routed to eng-platform — owner ben.platform.
